int_name: N BROAD ST & W GIRARD AVE

result.summary: This urban intersection is equipped with a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and a substantial concrete refuge island to assist pedestrians crossing the wide roadway. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the multi-lane configuration and visible pavement wear indicate a high-traffic environment that could be improved with further traffic calming.

hazards.name: Multi-lane crossing exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing the time spent in the roadway and exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Pavement degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking and uneven surfaces in the roadway near the crosswalk could pose a trip hazard or affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Ensure all crossing points have visible pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve safety and predictability.

interventions.title: Pavement Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway within the intersection to provide a smooth and safe crossing surface.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with multiple travel lanes and integrated streetcar tracks. While sidewalks and pedestrian signals are present, the long crossing distance and complex roadway geometry increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic and streetcar tracks, increasing exposure time in the roadway.

hazards.name: Streetcar tracks
hazards.description: Tracks in the roadway can be a tripping hazard or slippery for pedestrians during inclement weather.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised refuge island between the travel lanes and the streetcar tracks to allow for safer two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard parallel line markings to continental or ladder style for better visibility to approaching motorists.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and a central refuge island, providing basic infrastructure for crossing a wide multi-lane roadway. However, the significant crossing distance and degraded pavement surface within the intersection present challenges to pedestrian safety and comfort.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven patching in the center of the intersection can cause tripping or affect vehicle control.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a wide expanse, increasing exposure time to traffic despite the refuge island.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the intersection to eliminate trip hazards and improve the walking surface for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light, reducing conflicts with turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows an urban mixed-use street with streetcar tracks, sidewalks on both sides, and a signalized intersection. Pedestrian visibility is partially obstructed by street vendors and parked vehicles near the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Street vendor stalls and a parked white van near the intersection block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street at the intersection.

hazards.name: Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Tracks in the roadway can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians or a hazard for cyclists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility by preventing parking or stalls too close to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove obstructions like the market stalls and parked vehicles immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.
